name: Seams and Senses
source:
Limno, resident soft, shy, and gender-addled boygirl, is [s]useless[/s] coping well with the daily horrors of life. Sure, he's not much of a looker nor a moneymaker—like, he doesn't feel particularly interesting—yet somehow he's blessed with a sexy alt-goth dragon for a girlfriend... which is VERY validating and NOT stressful at all whatsoever! Limno is very good, promise, they even recently made a new friend! Could a depressed person do THAT?!?

Gloria, resident Is-She-A-Creep-comma-Autistic-comma-Or-Both-questionmark woman, has a relatively cushy job that she completely tunes out of, preferring to go on walks in the woods or to stay at home, looking at way-too-detailed images of monsters.  On one such walk, she spots a guy(?) staring at a dead bird, and... Well, that's that! Her obsession gene is now switched to ON. 

Surely only good things lie ahead for everyone involved.

[From [url=https://pengosolvent.itch.io/seams-and-senses]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Limno，一个温柔、害羞、性别混乱的男孩女孩，[s]useless[/s]，能够很好地应对生活中的日常恐怖。当然，他不太好看，也不是一个赚钱的人——就像，他感觉不是特别有趣——但不知何故，他有幸拥有一条性感的另类哥特龙作为女朋友……这非常有效，而且一点压力也没有！Limno非常好，保证，他们最近还交了一个新朋友！一个抑郁的人可以这样做吗？！？

格洛丽亚（Gloria）是一位居民，她是“她是一个蠕动逗号自闭症还是两个问号”的女人，她的工作相对轻松，但她完全不喜欢这种工作，她更喜欢在树林里散步或呆在家里，看着过于详细的怪物图像。在一次这样的散步中，她发现一个人（？）盯着一只死鸟，然后……嗯，就是这样！她的痴迷基因现在已开启。

当然，对于所有参与者来说，只有美好的事情等着我们。

[来自[url=https://pengosolvent.itch.io/seams-and-senses]itch.io[/url]]
